Package org.cibseven.spin.impl.json.jackson

package org.cibseven.spin.impl.json.jackson
Deprecated Jackson 2 variant of the Spin JSON data format.

Since CIB seven 3.0.0, cibseven-spin-dataformat-json-jackson and cibseven-spin-dataformat-all are built on Jackson 3 (tools.jackson). This artifact (cibseven-spin-dataformat-json-jackson2, shaded: cibseven-spin-dataformat-all-jackson2) keeps the Jackson 2 implementation of CIB seven 2.x with the same packages and class names as an escape hatch for applications that cannot move to Jackson 3 yet. Never put both variants on one classpath.

Deprecated: will be removed in CIB seven 3.1.0.
